;;; case E10_bareBuiltins_t01
(module cand :x [solve])
fn ! solve n: Int64 -> Int64
  (let [(a (+ n 1))
        (b (* n 1))
        (ws [a b (+ a b)])
        (opt (cond ((> b 0) (some b))
                   (else none)))
        (s (listSum ws))
        (result (cond ((some? opt) (+ s 1))
                      (else s)))]
    (let [(p (println result))]
      result))

  (let [(a (+ n 2))

        (ws [a b (+ a b)])
        (opt (cond ((> b 0) (some b)) (else none)))]
    (let [(s (listSum ws))
          (result (cond ((some? opt) (+ s 1)) (else s)))]
      (let [(p (println result))]
        result)))

  (let [(a (+ n 1)) (b (* n 1)) (ws [a b (+ a b)]) (opt (if (> b 0) (some b) none))]
    (if (some? opt) (+ (listSum ws) 1) (listSum ws)))

  (let [(a (+ n 1)) (b (* n 3)) (ws [a b (+ a b)]) (opt (cond ((> b 0) (some b)) (else none)))]
    (match opt ((some v) (+ (listSum ws) 1)) (none (listSum ws))))

;;; case E9_bangPrefix_t01
(module cand :x [solve])
fn ! solve n: Int64 -> Int64
  (let [(a (+ n 1))
        (b (* n 1))
        (ws [a b (+ a b)])
        (opt (if (> b 0) (some b) none))]
    (let [(s (listSum ws))
          (result (if (some? opt) (+ s 1) s))]
      (println result)
      result))
